Name: Meadowlands Minecarts
Author: zilchaz
Description:
I'm too lazy to walk...


Add minecarts on the Meadowlands farm map from the 1.6 version.

Two additional minecarts have been added.
[list=1]
[*]On the northwest of the map, close to Grandpa's shire.
[*]On the southeast, just outside the farmcave.
[/list]Both minecart locations can be deactivated via the config.json.


[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]This should be working with other Meadowlands map-edited mods.  (I personally used it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20742]Tweakable Meadowlands Farm[/url].)
[*]Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url].﻿
[/list]
